name: Coinbase and Kraken BTC/USD dispersion
description: One-second comparison of the two fresh exact-decimal constituent midpoints carried by the spot-reference processor. absolute_difference is the unsigned midpoint difference and dispersion_bps divides that difference by their equal-weight mean. leading_venue identifies the higher midpoint. reference_guard_state reports whether full-precision dispersion is within the spot-reference 10-basis-point guard. Divergence is a valid measurement for this signal; missing, stale, crossed, or otherwise invalid constituents degrade it. Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
